seo.description: A healthcare website redesign case study for Phoenix Ortho & Superspeciality Hospital, focused on clearer treatment discovery, clinical trust and patient-facing information hierarchy.

sections.heading: Project overview
sections.body: Phoenix Ortho & Superspeciality Hospital's existing website brings together the hospital introduction, treatments, facilities, doctor profiles, testimonials and contact information. This redesign case study reframes that content into a clearer, more contemporary digital experience focused on helping patients understand the hospital's services and find the right next step.

sections.heading: Redesign brief
sections.brief: Rework the hospital website so key care information — treatments, facilities, doctors and contact details — is easier to scan, understand and navigate.
sections.audience: Patients and families researching orthopedic and superspeciality care in and around Sangli.
sections.constraints: Preserve the hospital's established clinical offering and essential information while improving hierarchy, readability, trust and action clarity.

sections.heading: Redesign priorities
sections.body: The redesign direction is framed around the information patients need to evaluate a hospital and move confidently toward contact or care.

items.title: Clearer hierarchy
items.body: Separate the hospital introduction, treatment information, facilities, doctor profiles and supporting proof into a more deliberate reading order.

items.title: Treatment-led discovery
items.body: Make major orthopedic and superspeciality services easier to identify so visitors can quickly understand what the hospital treats.

items.title: Clinical trust
items.body: Give doctors, facilities and patient-facing credibility content stronger visual structure instead of letting important information compete for attention.

items.title: Visible next steps
items.body: Keep contact and appointment-oriented actions easy to find so the experience supports visitors who are ready to enquire or seek care.
